title: REQ · Entry point resolves to App and is covered by a render test
summary: index.html loads src/main.tsx which mounts App into #root, proven by unit tests
description: Context: index.html loads /src/main.tsx, which calls createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />) with a non-null assertion that gives an opaque error if #root is absent. Desired behavior: main.tsx fails with a clear message when #root is missing and mounts App otherwise; tests prove the chain index.html -> main.tsx -> App renders. Why: entry point must resolve.
acceptance_criteria: Given index.html, when read, then it has a div#root and a module script with src /src/main.tsx
Given a document with #root, when main.tsx is imported, then createRoot is called with that element and render receives the App element
Given a document without #root, when main.tsx is imported, then it throws an error whose message is 'Root element #root not found'
Given App rendered in a test, when no interaction occurs, then the intro Begin button is shown
